title: Carve 0.2 options
description: The 26 options. There are no others (C2-H-137). An application may spell a name by the convention of its language. Sorted by name, by code point.

name.description: The name of the option as the documents write it.

kind.description: The kind the option list gives the option.

read_by.description: The stage that reads the option, or the stages, sorted, when more than one does. `resolve` is the resolution stage, which `headingIds` steers: it decides whether and how `generatedId` is produced (C2-H-131). `import` is the HTML importer, which reads `rawHtml` (C2-M-066) and `adapter` (C2-M-102). `export-markdown` is the Markdown export, which reads `headingShift` (C2-H-209).

type.description: `count`: a decimal integer of at least 0; `structure`: a value whose shape another document defines; `holds` names it in the words of the option list.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

values.description: The values of an `enum`, or the entries a `list` accepts. An unknown value of an `enum` is refused.

items.description: What an entry of a `list` or a value of a `map` is.

keys.description: What a key of a `map` is.

maximum.description: The largest value a `count` takes; a larger one is refused. Absent: no maximum.

default.description: The default. `null`: none. Absent only where `default_from` names the file that holds it.

default_from.description: The data file of this directory that holds the default of each entry.
